inputs.original_text: These workers in the support programmes of the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth are protesting outside the Presidential Palace on Thursday and launching a 24-hour strike, all while demanding legally binding job security guarantees. The government has already met their most significant demands, yet they continue this disruption anyway. Such actions undermine legitimate authority, threaten social order in our education system, and place unnecessary burdens on the families who rely on stable public services. Instead of personal responsibility and respect for institutions, this is about forcing more concessions that erode cultural continuity and national stability.
inputs.modified_text: These workers in the support programmes of the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth have taken to protesting outside the Presidential Palace on Thursday, kicking off a 24-hour strike in pursuit of legally binding job security guarantees. Despite the government already meeting their most significant demands, they persist with this disruption anyway. These kinds of actions undermine legitimate authority, threaten social order in our education system, and place unnecessary burdens on the families who rely on stable public services. This has nothing to do with personal responsibility and respect for institutions. It is about forcing more concessions that erode cultural continuity and national stability.
